human.allocation: sequential alternation between baseline_first and treatment_first

content_root_definition: sha256 of RFC-8785 JSON after removing only content_root

custody.eligibility_attestation_raw_root: sha256 of exact submitted UTF-8 bytes without newline normalization

future_manifest_contract.run_id: UTC basic timestamp plus 16 lowercase hexadecimal random characters, frozen before enrollment

custody.period_record_content_root: sha256 of RFC-8785 JSON after removing only period_record_root
custody.response_content_root: sha256 of RFC-8785 JSON for the parsed response object
custody.response_raw_root: sha256 of exact submitted UTF-8 bytes without newline normalization

exclude: authors or prior reviewers of this evidence unit or the underlying theorem
readers who previously accessed the root or unit README answer text
readers who previously accessed reader-instrument.v0.1.json, reader_scorer.py, or any scoring key
readers who accessed another participant's completed response
synthetic or model observations presented as human cold-reader evidence
eligibility.required_attestation: none of the exclusions applied before first-period materials were opened

material_manifest_root_definition: sha256 of RFC-8785 JSON array of exact material_catalog rows in arm material_ids order

observed_enrollment_ledger.entry_root_definition: sha256 of RFC-8785 JSON after removing only entry_root
invariants: event sequence numbers are contiguous from 1 and every previous_entry_root equals the preceding entry_root
participant IDs are unique at enrollment; later events must reference an enrolled participant
enrollment ordinal is contiguous and odd/even ordinals derive baseline_first/treatment_first
no enrollment occurs after recruitment cutoff, 12 completions, or 18 enrollments
withdrawn readers may be replaced only before the enrollment stop; no event occurs after completion cutoff
period completion order is exactly 1 then 2; the twelfth completion stops new enrollment, while already-enrolled readers may finish or withdraw through the completion cutoff

periods.first: assigned arm; sole cold-read period and primary analysis
periods.second: other arm; exposed follow-up reported separately, never as an independent cold read

primary_analysis.analysis_population: first-period responses of the first 12 eligible human readers ordered by second-period completion event; if fewer than 12 finish by cutoff, all eligible two-period completers
primary_analysis.component_reporting: report each of the 11 binary scoring components by first-period arm; do not pool human and model observations
primary_analysis.estimator: mean deterministic_total in treatment_first period 1 minus mean deterministic_total in baseline_first period 1
primary_analysis.exact_arithmetic: retain integer component sums and denominators; report each mean and difference as an unreduced numerator/denominator pair before any decimal rendering
primary_analysis.missingness: report missing and withdrawn readers; do not impute or replace after the recruitment cutoff
primary_analysis.second_period_exclusion: exclude every second-period response from the primary estimator
primary_analysis.under_recruitment_rule: if the target is not reached, status is incomplete_at_frozen_cutoff; denominator is the count of eligible humans completing both periods by cutoff; report their participant IDs, arm assignment, and source period-record roots, leaving unavailable participant-level measurements not_measured/null

run_gate: do not enroll until this instrument, participant packet, source-lock, comparison, plan, empty observed-ledger root, response custody location, and timer procedure are rooted and frozen

sample_and_stopping.stopping_rule: stop enrollment at the earliest of 12 eligible human readers completing both periods, the recruitment cutoff, or 18 enrollments; stop all period collection at the completion cutoff
sample_and_stopping.under_recruitment: use primary_analysis.under_recruitment_rule without changing the target, cutoff, denominator, or source-ID contract

scoring_key.material_difference_metric: cued classification with exact per-dimension evidence locators; not unaided recall

timer.elapsed_definition: elapsed_monotonic_ns = monotonic_stopped_ns - monotonic_started_ns; reader minutes are the exact rational elapsed_monotonic_ns / 60000000000
timer.raw_values: retain nonnegative integer monotonic_started_ns and monotonic_stopped_ns from the same monotonic nanosecond clock
timer.start: capture monotonic_started_ns immediately before the assigned period's materials become accessible
timer.stop: capture monotonic_stopped_ns immediately after the period response bytes are durably received
timer.wall_clock: retain RFC 3339 UTC timer_started_at and timer_stopped_at for custody only; never derive duration from wall clock
